column1: # The NPDM declares 48 MiB of system resources. Startup requests a 6.20 GiB heap.
# The frame step (patches.py, main e0f3ccfa…): the host picks each frame's vsyncs and hands them to sead::GameFrameworkOunce's interval setter, so game time keeps to real
# time when 60 fps does not hold (it played slow at 20-40 fps: the game fixes interval 1 itself). Unverified that the logic steps by the interval (the game note)
# A frame longer than 50 ms used to lose time (the hold stopped at 3 vsyncs): game time 0.71 of real time at 20 fps on an M4. The interval setter takes 4 (fps = 60 / interval)
# agl wraps its depth clears in render conditions, as on Donkey Kong Bananza and Splatoon Raiders: in Kokiri Forest the main opaque pass tests EQUAL against a copy of the prepass depth
# that a conditional clear (skipped on the console) wiped first, so no lit geometry landed and the full-screen sky showed through everywhere (a white scene)
